function: Excluded (function): the learned model detects which devices are active in IRS-aided grant-free random access, not symbol recovery, channel estimation or RIS configuration (pp. 1-2, 4).
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match (Mixture of Experts-Augmented Deep Unfolding for Activity Detection in IRS-Aided Systems). Learned part passes no_learning: deep-unfolded projected gradient with trainable parameters plus an MLP gating network (p. 3). Excluded for function: the output is the activity estimate a_k of each device, thresholded to decide active or silent (p. 4, P_F and P_M); activity detection is not symbol recovery (area 1), channel estimation or feedback (area 2) or RIS configuration (area 3), and the IRS phase-shift matrix is only given as a system parameter (p. 2). Borderline: if the reviewer treats device activity detection as multiuser detection (area 1), the relevant facts are a BS with 32 antennas and an IRS with 40 elements, a custom Rician/Rayleigh simulator with its own path loss (p. 4), baselines CD, PGD, two unfolding methods and a transformer (p. 4), O(I(M^3+LM)) complexity (p. 4), inference time (p. 5) and no code link.
